throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: fcmp.cle.s $fcc0, $f8, $f9; fcmp.cle.s $fcc1, $f10, $f11; fcmp.cle.s $fcc2, $f12, $f13; fcmp.cle.s $fcc3, $f14, $f15; fcmp.cle.s $fcc4, $f16, $f17; fcmp.cle.s $fcc5, $f18, $f19; fcmp.cle.s $fcc6, $f20, $f21; fcmp.cle.s $fcc7, $f22, $f23
throughput.init: li.d $r4, 0x3ff0000000000000; movgr2fr.d $f8, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f9, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f10, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f11, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f12, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f13, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f14, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f15, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f16, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f17, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f18, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f19, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f20, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f21, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f22, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f23, $r4
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --init 'li.d $r4, 0x3ff0000000000000; movgr2fr.d $f8, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f9, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f10, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f11, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f12, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f13, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f14, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f15, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f16, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f17, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f18, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f19, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f20, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f21, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f22, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f23, $r4' --asm 'fcmp.cle.s $fcc0, $f8, $f9; fcmp.cle.s $fcc1, $f10, $f11; fcmp.cle.s $fcc2, $f12, $f13; fcmp.cle.s $fcc3, $f14, $f15; fcmp.cle.s $fcc4, $f16, $f17; fcmp.cle.s $fcc5, $f18, $f19; fcmp.cle.s $fcc6, $f20, $f21; fcmp.cle.s $fcc7, $f22, $f23'

notes: FCMP writes a condition-code register. Individual latency is not separable without a round trip through movcf2gr/movgr2fr; throughput only. A round trip fcmp+movcf2gr+movgr2fr measured about 5.02 cycles.
